After receiving a request, the C2 script first checks if the logging directory exists, if not, it will create one.
Next, the script checks for a specific COOKIE ID.
If it exists and corresponds to the hardcoded value, then the C2 script will act as a web shell.
It will base64 decode the value of the $_COOKIE (not to be confused with the authentication COOKIE ID) entry and execute it on the C2 server as a command.
